product.olivetti-m20-st.summary: The M20 configuration that the Italian press identified as ST in 1982.
product.olivetti-m20-st.history: In 1982, Pixel documented the M20 ST as part of Olivetti’s professional range. The Museo del Calcolatore in Prato holds a specimen with that designation.
product.olivetti-m20-st.architecture: Memory could be expanded with cards. Pixel describes 128–224 KB with three cards and the museum gives up to 512 KB for the family.
product.olivetti-m20-st.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m20-st.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m20-st.pixel-1982: Pixel 2, 1982, pp. 59–60, Olivetti Personal Computer M20 ST
product.olivetti-m20-st.prato-museum: Museo del Calcolatore di Prato, Olivetti M20 ST
